title: Apprise
summary: APPRI'SE, verb transitive s as z. [See Apprehend.] To inform; to give notice, verbal or written; followed by of; as, we will apprise the general of an intended attack; he apprised the commander of wha

inlines.v: APPRI'SE, verb transitive s as z. [See Apprehend.] To inform; to give notice, verbal or written; followed by of; as, we will apprise the general of an intended attack; he apprised the commander of what he had done.
